idea: Basic plumbing maintenance every homeowner should know
title: Essential Homeowner Maintenance: Exercising Your Shut-Off Valves
description: One of the most critical plumbing maintenance habits for any homeowner is regularly testing emergency shut-off valves. Angle stop valves located beneath sinks and toilets often sit untouched for years, causing internal seals to degrade and mineral scale to lock the handle in place. Every six months, gently turn each valve handle clockwise until it closes completely, then turn it counterclockwise to reopen it fully. This simple habit keeps the valve operational so you can instantly turn off water during an emergency. Always inspect around the packing nut for fine leaks or corrosion after exercising the valve.
